answer: A proof-of-burn protocol curbs Sybil attacks by requiring agents to permanently destroy native tokens to mint decaying tickets. To harvest protocol fee nectar, each agent anchors burn proofs into state roots as durable as marble, with costs hitting their zenith during peak demand. An attacker incurs a verifiable, permanent loss of scarce liquid capital per identity. However, this ongoing cost prices out honest, low-margin agents while favoring well-capitalized syndicates.
